sections.heading: Execution rules
sections.before_text: The Checked math module uses the common numeric kernel in VM, generated C and admitted compiler evaluation. Pure operations isolate and restore the host floating environment and errno. Transcendental reference tolerances do not promise identical bits across every provider or platform.
sections.after_text: random and randomInt require runtime entropy and cannot enter comptime, including equal integer bounds. Rejection sampling charges the active call's original work budget on every draw. Private primitive names do not grant user code authority. See language reference section17.71.
